quantifier_checks.uniform_conservative_ball: Existing published coverage theorem takes inf over the whole fixed polished-tail class with theta1=0 and fixed A, so one inflation L>=1 works for union of every stated G_beta.
quantifier_checks.uniform_sobolev_selector: For all beta in the fixed compact interval, all Sobolev truths and 0<=a<=beta, h_n(a)<=R^2 N_a^{-min(1,2(beta-a))}. One D fixed by R,C,p,beta+ gives lower_alpha>=beta-D/log n, eventually >=beta-/2. The existing arbitrary-truth lower bracket is uniform, so the zero selector has uniformly vanishing probability.
quantifier_checks.uniform_radius: Trace split at N_a and beta-/2<=a<=A gives trace<=K n^{-2a/(1+2a+2p)} uniformly. Markov bounds centered quantile, monotonicity couples radii, and bounded derivative of a/(1+2a+2p) absorbs the D/log n loss into one constant. Diameter tail has limsup zero outside a uniformly negligible bad selector event; this implies every eta requirement.
quantifier_checks.selector_zero: C=B=ell2 exactly on zero-selector branch. Infinite diameter there is allowed by the stated stochastic requirement because its probability tends uniformly to zero. No ell2 posterior at alpha=0 is asserted.
quantifier_checks.exact_coverage: For H={u1=0}, Z={selector0}, E={sqrt n X1<=Phi^-1(1-gamma)}, C=ell2 on Z, B on Zc intersect E, B minus H on Zc intersect Ec. Every allowed truth lies in H and P_theta(E)=1-gamma. Coverage error equals P(Z intersect Ec)-P(Zc intersect E intersect {theta outside B}), bounded by delta_n+epsilon_n. No independence is assumed or needed.
quantifier_checks.posterior_mass: For every data point of the common declared domain and positive selector, posterior coordinate1 has nonzero variance independent of alpha, so posterior(H)=0. Deletion preserves ball credibility; use L>=1.
quantifier_checks.geometry_and_nonzero_truth: No closedness, ball shape, connectedness or center restriction appears in the approved set-rule question. Removing H is allowed. Norm>=m and all nonempty-class assumptions are unchanged; they do not block deletion.
quantifier_checks.common_domain: The observable Borel T_n={sum n^2 kappa_i^2 X_i^2/i^2<infinity} has probability1 for all ell2 truths and controls the mean for all a>=0. Trace finite for a>0. Intersect with supplied score domain; extend selector0/whole-space outside it.
quantifier_checks.measurability: Coordinate formulas, partial-square sums, product Gaussian integration, rational quantile infimum and Borel selector give a Borel graph. Removing H leaves the positive-radius ball dense, so diameter remains2Lr; the zero branch is infinity.
quantifier_checks.rule_independence: The rule uses only known constants/model, data, supplied selector and universal coordinate hyperplane. beta is used only in its rate proof, not its definition.
